title: GPhyT + Block Attention Residuals beats GPhyT without Attention Residuals and all other tested baselines on radiative flow
summary: On this study's radiative-flow full test set, GPhyT + Block Attention Residuals has the lowest mean 12-step NMSE among all nine tested trained, initialized, and persistence models: 0.28917. That is 26.38% lower than GPhyT without Attention Residuals (0.39277) and 30.99% lower than persistence (0.41901).
scope: This is a descriptive mean ranking, emphasized after results, not a win in every seed. Standard/Block use six seeds and Full/Uniform three; initialized controls are post-hoc. The preregistered two-dataset test remains separate and does not establish significance against every comparator.
